name: Solar Wind Chime Forest
description: A forest of metallic trees whose leaves are tuned chimes, played by the solar wind into a celestial melody.
prompt: Open field under a bright sky. Trees made of polished copper and silver with thin, leaf‑shaped chimes. A gentle solar wind (visualized as faint golden streams) passes through, causing the chimes to vibrate. Sound waves visualized as subtle ripples in the air. Photorealistic, bright daylight, intricate metalwork detail.
caption: Hear the sun’s own lullaby 🎵☀️ #SolarChimes
